_comment: F10#4 round 3 (code-blind judge: one near pylon and one faint far one do not read as a line): spacing 38 -> 26 m. V-VIS-9 / F10#4 (code-blind judge: the rod line was only gold stripes painted on the road; no rods, scaffold, copper or cable). Team Tether's rod line made physical from installed art: the Team Tether rod pylon (the rod stations' own model, smaller) stands beside the critical road every spacing_m, offset side_offset_m from the centreline on the side_sign side of the flow toward the Dynamo, and a sagging copper cable with a pale-violet charge bead runs pylon to pylon toward the Stormheart. Presentation only: no colliders, nothing on a simulation_only world. Pylons skip exclusion_radius_m around settlements, arches and footings, camps, rod stations, trainers and pocket spur junctions; a span longer than max_span_m (a skipped pylon) gets no cable. After stormwood:long_storm_ended the pylons go dark (tether_pylon_materials unlit) and the charge beads go out.
